sources.title: Introducing OpenAI o3 and o4-mini
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The launch calls o4-mini smaller and more efficient, without a nominal count or a named counted-base relationship. April 16, 2025 announcement explicitly makes o4-mini available that day in ChatGPT and through Chat Completions and Responses. Describes reinforcement-learned reasoning, image input and function calling. The 256K SWE-bench evaluation setting is distinct from the documented API context. Hosted image generation is a tool, not native output.

sources.title: OpenAI o3 and o4-mini System Card
sources.evidence: Rechecked the freshly fetched complete original PDF on October 27, 2026, including Model Data and Training and full-text count searches. Downloaded the complete original card and inspected its introduction, Model Data and Training section, and full-text parameter/topology matches. It documents o-series reinforcement learning and tool-assisted visual reasoning, without a production o4-mini total/active count, dense/MoE topology or layer configuration. Safety evaluation scores and research checkpoints are not architecture specifications.

sources.title: o4-mini model reference
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026 and read the freshly fetched exact Markdown reference; no numerical total or active count appears. The complete Markdown reference binds o4-mini to o4-mini-2025-04-16 and marks both shut down. Last documented specifications are 200,000 context, 100,000 maximum output, text/image input, text output, reasoning tokens and function calling. It explicitly lists file uploads, prompt caching and cached-input pricing. Native image generation, audio and video endpoints are unsupported.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Archived engineering recipe explicitly applies to models before GPT-5.6 and names o4-mini among caching models. Section 2.1 describes forward passes through Transformer layers and attention key/value projections across layers and heads. With exact o4-mini caching support, this supports a qualified broad Transformer inference only; no count or dense/MoE inference follows.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: The file-input guide says PDF parsing on vision-capable models passes extracted text and page images to the model. Combined with exact o4-mini image input, Responses support and file_uploads support, this establishes PDF as an API input format rather than a separate native neural modality.

sources.title: OpenAI API deprecations
sources.evidence: The April 22, 2026 legacy-snapshot notice explicitly lists o4-mini-2025-04-16 and alias o4-mini as shut down October 23, 2026. The exact API reference agrees; this is distinct from the later December shutdown scheduled for o3. Endpoint operation was not tested.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Sections 2.2 and 9.1 provide limited service-access rights and reserve OpenAI intellectual-property rights. Alongside the hosted release/API documentation, this supports descriptive Proprietary classification, not an open-weight or SPDX license.

sources.title: gpt-oss-120b & gpt-oss-20b Model Card
sources.evidence: Rechecked the freshly fetched complete report on October 27, 2026, including Table 1 and exact o4-mini benchmark columns. Shared tokenizer ancestry and performance similarity do not identify o4-mini as a gpt-oss variant. Downloaded the full later report and inspected architecture/count disclosures and exact o4-mini comparisons, including Table 2 MMMLU and Tables 4–5 safety evaluations. Table 1 gives counts only for gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b. The o4-mini columns report performance, not total or active parameters; gpt-oss MoE structure cannot be transferred.

sources.title: GPT-5 System Card
sources.evidence: Rechecked the freshly fetched complete report on October 27, 2026. Table 1 calls gpt-5-thinking-mini a successor of o4-mini, not a counted base or unchanged variant; neither has a parameter count here. Downloaded the full later report and checked exact o4-mini comparison columns, including Table 8 SimpleQA and Appendix 1 Tables 23–26 safety/image evaluations, plus parameter/topology terminology across the text. These disclose evaluation results, not production o4-mini total/active counts or routing structure.

sources.title: Thinking with images
sources.evidence: The April 16 research explanation says o4-mini reasons with user-uploaded images, using cropping/zooming/rotation tools. Visual reasoning is native rather than delegated to a separate specialist; image generation is a separate tool. It provides behavioral/visual evidence, not parameter counts or a detailed architecture.

sources.title: Stress Testing Deliberative Alignment for Anti-Scheming Training
sources.evidence: Rechecked the freshly fetched complete report on October 27, 2026, especially Section 3.2. The named SFT/RL relationship is explicit, but neither production o4-mini nor its AS derivative receives a numerical total or active count. Followed the official OpenAI research announcement through antischeming.ai to the complete paper. Section 3.2 explicitly starts from production o4-mini and applies SFT then RL to make a distinct o4-mini AS experimental model. Reviewed that procedure and full-text structural/count matches; no production parameter count or dense/MoE topology is disclosed. Experimental results do not modify this production record.

sources.title: Model Release Notes: o4-mini update, June 6, 2025
sources.evidence: June 6 notes announce rollback of an o4-mini snapshot deployed less than a week earlier to improve response length because content flags increased. They provide no dated API identifier or parameter count. This product update is not evidence that the documented April 16 API snapshot changed.

sources.title: Models.dev o4-mini record
sources.evidence: Inspected the exact upstream record as a discovery lead. Primary sources independently confirm release, context and capabilities. The o-mini grouping and missing technical fields are not independent evidence.

sources.title: Can Large Reasoning Models Reason about Spatial Relations?
sources.evidence: Reopened the original author-hosted 11-page PDF on October 27, 2026. Table 1 explicitly identifies o4-mini-2025-04-16-high and marks Number of Parameters Undisclosed, while separately giving an activated count for DeepSeek. This original study supplies no total or active number for o4-mini; high is its reasoning setting.

sources.title: Ontology Learning with LLMs: A Benchmark Study on Axiom Identification
sources.publisher: Bakker et al., Semantic Web journal submission
sources.evidence: Downloaded the complete original PDF with HTTP 200 on October 27, 2026 after the web reader timed out. Table 4 lists exact o4-mini-2025-04-16 at approximately 100B, but Section 4.2 explicitly says OpenAI parameter counts are not publicly disclosed and its sizes are estimates based on prior work, reference 45 (MEDEC, 2024). This is an estimate used by a benchmark study, not a developer specification or an original model-team counting convention. It provides no active count; the estimate is not adopted.

sources.title: Qwen3 Technical Report
sources.evidence: Reopened the original May 2025 report on October 27, 2026 and checked its explicit Total Params and Activated Params comparison tables. o4-mini appears in the cited OpenAI launch title but has no identified parameter-count row. Counts for Qwen or other compared models cannot transfer to o4-mini.

sources.title: Large Language Models for Zero-Shot Procedure Extraction in Orthopedic Surgery: A Comparative Evaluation
sources.evidence: October 27, 2026 search indexing exposes Table 1 with gpt-o4-mini-2025-04-16 and dashes in both Params and Active Params. Direct original PDF and HTML opens returned HTTP 403. The final Scientific Reports article was readable but its separate model table redirected to an inaccessible authentication route. This remains an indexed lead, not a claimed full-table inspection or count evidence.

developer.note: OpenAI released and documented this model.

family.note: Catalog generation/series grouping follows the o4 model name within the broader o-series. It does not assert identical weights or topology with o4-mini-deep-research or any other variant.

release_date.note: Contemporaneous announcement explicitly grants same-day ChatGPT and API access. Later rollouts and the June snapshot rollback do not replace the first release date.

open_weights.note: Documented distribution is hosted ChatGPT/API access under service terms; no downloadable checkpoint or open-weight grant accompanies this model.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the hosted model under OpenAI terms, not an SPDX assertion.

parameters_b.note: The October 27 fresh review found no supported nominal total in the exact launch/card/API, later OpenAI reports or original comparison tables. GeoAI explicitly marks the dated model undisclosed. The approximately 100B ontology-study figure is explicitly estimated and is not adopted. Named AS post-training and GPT-5 successor relationships provide no counted base.

active_parameters_b.note: The October 27 fresh review found no explicit nominal active count for o4-mini in the original sources or later model-team parameter tables. gpt-oss and Qwen counts describe other models; neither tokenizer sharing nor benchmark similarity establishes count lineage. No active count is inferred from total size, density or reasoning effort.

architecture.note: Qualified broad inference from exact o4-mini prompt-caching support and the applicable pre-GPT-5.6 engineering explanation of Transformer layers, which explicitly names o4-mini. The original and training reports do not disclose dense versus MoE, layer counts or other production topology.

context_window.note: Last documented API context, in tokens, separate from 100,000 maximum output. The launch footnote uses a 256K SWE-bench evaluation configuration; that does not override the exact API limit. The API is documented as shut down.

modalities.note: Native text/image input and text output. PDF is an API file format converted to extracted text and page images. Tool-mediated image generation does not establish native image output, and no audio/video input or output is claimed.

reasoning.note: The launch/card document reinforcement-learned chain-of-thought reasoning; the API explicitly supports reasoning tokens. Higher effort variants are settings, not a new parameter-count disclosure.

tool_call.note: Function calling is explicit in both the original launch and exact API reference. Later Responses hosted-tool support is not retroactively assigned to the launch-day API.

sources.label: Model Release Notes: o4-mini update, June 6, 2025

patch.notes: The o4-mini alias is documented as pointing to o4-mini-2025-04-16; OpenAI lists both as shut down on October 23, 2026. Context and capabilities are last documented API specifications, not a live endpoint test. The June 6, 2025 rollback notice does not identify an API snapshot, so it is not treated as a change to the dated API model. Transformer is a broad inference from exact prompt-caching support and OpenAI's applicable pre-GPT-5.6 engineering explanation; dense versus MoE remains undisclosed. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed after a fresh source review; the published approximately 100B estimate is not a developer specification. PDF is an API input format converted to text and page images. Image generation is a hosted tool, not native o4-mini output. The 256K SWE-bench evaluation setting does not replace the documented 200K API context.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit: total and active counts remain undisclosed after reopening the exact launch, system card and API reference; later gpt-oss, GPT-5 and anti-scheming reports; and original comparison research. GeoAI labels the dated model undisclosed. Rejected the ontology study's approximately 100B figure because the authors explicitly estimate closed-model sizes; no counted named-base relationship supplies a nominal inference. Added explicit null count patches and null parameters_source. The other 12 field assessments are unchanged.
